title: Croatian Spring Pasta Bake
description: A delicious and easy-to-make pasta bake infused with the flavors of Croatia. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, combine Croatian zesty sauce and chopped parsley.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta and sauce mixture.
Transfer pasta mixture to a baking dish.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake in preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
